tree.heading: Eligibility.—
tree.text: An individual who has been awarded the Medal of Honor as presented by Congress is eligible for membership in the corporation. An honorary membership may not be granted.

tree.heading: Voting.—
tree.text: Each member has one vote on each matter submitted to a vote at a meeting of the members. The vote may be cast in person or by proxy.
